bug: Document export allowed reentrant consumption of its active result or error, causing duplicate cleanup. The checkpoint-only reservation did not protect aliases crossing between document and checkpoint readers.

before.observations: Cleanup counters reached two instead of one for eight document-result inspection stages, three shared-error stages, and result/error aliases in both cross-reader directions.

fix: Reserve document results before caller metadata inspection and cloned errors before their cleanup getters.
Share active identity reservations with the checkpoint reader, rejecting overlapping ownership without freeing the active handle.
Keep reservations through cleanup and release them in finally; preserve independent nested reads and caller ownership when protected-list capture fails.

browserIntegration.scope: Complete editor.spec.ts: editing, selections, IME, clipboard, document export, checkpoints, history, toolbars, formatting and automated accessibility checks.

limits: Reservations cover the document and checkpoint readers within one loaded module graph, not unrelated adapters or separately loaded package copies.
This is not a persistent consumed-handle registry; callers must not reuse already-freed generated handles.
Synthetic unit handles reproduce reentry; the real-browser suite checks normal integration behavior.
